title: REQ · React highlightObject events drive scene object focus
summary: BootScene consumes highlightObject to focus or blur the matching SceneObject and unsubscribes on shutdown
description: Context: ReactToPhaserEvents.highlightObject is declared but unused; SceneObject already has focus() and blur() that show highlight and label. Desired behavior: BootScene subscribes to reactToPhaser highlightObject in create(). Expected result: React can highlight a scene object. Why: completes the React to Phaser direction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with objects, when highlightObject is emitted with an object id, then that object is focused and all others blurred
Given a highlighted object, when highlightObject is emitted with null, then every object is blurred
Given the scene shuts down, when highlightObject is emitted afterwards, then no object is touched
definition_of_done: highlightObject focuses and clears objects; listener removed on shutdown
non_functional: No listener leak across scene restarts
